This script creates figures for the number of H. monorchis individuals in the monitoring plots.

## Install packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sciplot)
library(boot)
library(Matrix)
library(lme4)
library(vegan)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(openxlsx)



```

## Load data

```{r}

df <- read_excel(here::here("data", "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2026.xlsx"), sheet="Plot_herminium",na=c("NA"))
```

## Create figures

### Number of individuals per plot, per locality

```{r}

# Create and save a figure for one locality
create_figure <- function(locality_name, all_plots_only = FALSE) {

  locality_data <- df %>%
    filter(locality_name == Locality)

  if (all_plots_only) {
    plot_data <- locality_data %>%
      mutate(plot_type = "Alle ruter")
  } else {
    plot_data <- bind_rows(
      locality_data %>%
        filter(All_years == 1) %>%
        mutate(plot_type = "Opprinnelige ruter"),

      locality_data %>%
        mutate(plot_type = "Alle ruter")
    )
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      plot_type = factor(
        plot_type,
        levels = c("Opprinnelige ruter", "Alle ruter")
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(plot_type, Year) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(Herminium_density_0.25m2)),
      mean_density = mean(Herminium_density_0.25m2, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sd(Herminium_density_0.25m2, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Plot means ± standard errors
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = Year, y = mean_density, group = 1)
  ) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_density - se,
        ymax = mean_density + se
      ),
      width = 0.15
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ plot_type, nrow = 1) +
    labs(
      title = locality_name,
      x = "År",
      y = "Antall individer per 0,25 m²"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16)

  # Save figure
  ggsave(
    filename = here::here(
      "img",
      paste0(locality_name, "_antall.jpg")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = if (all_plots_only) 17.5 else 35,
    height = 20,
    units = "cm",
    dpi = 300
  )

  return(p)
}

# Create and save figures
p_skipstadsand <- create_figure("Skipstadsand")
p_skjellvik <- create_figure("Skjellvik")
p_teneskjaer <- create_figure("Teneskjaer")
p_filletassen <- create_figure("Filletassen", all_plots_only = TRUE)

# Display figures
p_skipstadsand
p_skjellvik
p_teneskjaer
p_filletassen
```

### Percentage of fertile individuals

```{r}

# Replace NA fractions with zero and summarise per locality and year
# Replace NA with zero except in 2018, when data are missing
fertile_summary <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Herminium_fraction_fertile = if_else(
      Year == 2018,
      Herminium_fraction_fertile,
      coalesce(Herminium_fraction_fertile, 0)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Locality, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Herminium_fraction_fertile)),
    mean_fraction = if (n > 0) {
      mean(Herminium_fraction_fertile, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    se = if (n > 1) {
      sd(Herminium_fraction_fertile, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot means ± standard errors
p_fertile <- ggplot(
  fertile_summary,
  aes(x = Year, y = mean_fraction, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_fraction - se),
      ymax = pmin(1, mean_fraction + se)
    ),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Locality, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(decimal.mark = ","),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "År",
    y = "Andel fertile individer"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.5))

# Display figure
p_fertile

# Save figure
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "Andel_fertile_per_lokalitet.jpg"),
  plot = p_fertile,
  width = 30,
  height = 22,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300
)
```
